task_completion.description: Log into the Nx Witness Desktop Client using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness interface is visible, showing the local server connected in the resource tree (left sidebar) and the 'admin' user logged in.

task_completion.description: Open the Event Rules configuration dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'Event Rules' is open on top of the main client interface.

task_completion.description: Configure the event trigger as a 'Soft Trigger' named 'Activate Lockdown'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Event Rule dialog, the 'Event' type is set to 'Soft Trigger' and the 'Name' field contains 'Activate Lockdown'.

task_completion.description: Set the trigger to be available to all users on all devices.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Event Rule settings, 'At' is set to 'All Devices' and 'Available to' is set to 'All Users'.

task_completion.description: Set the action to 'Show Text Overlay' with the specific alert text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Action' type is set to 'Show Text Overlay' and the 'Text' field contains 'SECURITY ALERT: LOCKDOWN'.

task_completion.description: Set the overlay duration to at least 5 seconds on all cameras.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Interval of Action' or 'Duration' is set to 5 seconds (or more), and the 'At' field under the Action section is set to 'All Cameras'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI rather than just executing scripts in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness Desktop Client menus and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent actually created a new rule rather than just viewing an existing one.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the process of clicking 'Add' in the Event Rules dialog and typing the required text.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a script to inject the rule directly into the database/API without using the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the manual navigation through the 'System Administration' or 'Event Rules' menus.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The trigger name must be exactly 'Activate Lockdown' (case-insensitive). The overlay text must be 'SECURITY ALERT: LOCKDOWN' (case-insensitive). The duration must be at least 5 seconds (5000ms). The server credentials are admin/Admin1234!.
